The '''Elbara system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Elbaran sector/Legends|Elbaran sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Elbara Nine]].
